name: Features, headline stack
description: A stack of giant one-word lines, each a link with a short description beside it, that fill with the primary colour on hover or focus.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: One £14 day pass opens all of it

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Gritstone is a climbing hall in an old steel works in Kelham Island, open from 7 am to 10 pm every day of the year.

itemFields.name: name
itemFields.label: Giant line
itemFields.help: One or two short words read best.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Description
itemFields.default: Flat whites, flapjacks and a view of the main wall.

default.name: Bouldering
default.text: 320 problems on 4.5 metre walls, reset every Monday and graded from first day to font 8a.

default.name: Top rope
default.text: Forty lines up to 17 metres, twelve of them on auto belays so you can climb alone.

default.name: Training
default.text: A 45 degree board, campus rungs and a weights room that stays quiet until 4 pm.

default.name: Kids club
default.text: Coached sessions for ages 6 to 14 every Saturday morning, shoes included.

default.name: Sauna
default.text: Eight seats, cedar benches and a cold tap, free with every pass.
